s01_passedon.title: The best deals I've ever passed on
s01_passedon.hook: The best deals I've seen? I passed on them.
s01_passedon.why_viral: Contrarian gut-punch: the pro brags about the deals he said NO to.
s01_passedon.spoken_gist: The best-looking deals are the ones he passes on because the margins are paper thin; passing on the bad ones protects the good ones.

s02_fastisnt.title: Funded in days is not careless
s02_fastisnt.hook: We fund in days. No, we are not skipping steps.
s02_fastisnt.why_viral: Myth-bust that reframes a suspected weakness (speed) as earned expertise.
s02_fastisnt.spoken_gist: Funding fast is not cutting corners; they move fast because they do the work fast after hundreds of deals.

s03_100k1or3.title: Same $100K: one flip or three?
s03_100k1or3.why_viral: Concrete number plus a curiosity gap that forces the viewer to stay for the mechanism.
s03_100k1or3.spoken_gist: With $100K you could do one flip, or three with that same $100K; it is understanding how capital works.

s04_scalenotharder.title: You scale by capital, not effort
s04_scalenotharder.hook: You don't scale by working harder.
s04_scalenotharder.why_viral: Counterintuitive payoff that reframes hustle culture: smarter capital, not more work.
s04_scalenotharder.spoken_gist: The same $100K works across two or three projects at once; you scale by deploying capital efficiently, not by working harder.

s05_prosuseit.title: The best investors don't avoid hard money
s05_prosuseit.hook: Pros don't avoid hard money. They live on it.
s05_prosuseit.why_viral: Kills the beginner assumption that hard money is a last resort.
s05_prosuseit.spoken_gist: Experienced investors use hard money on almost every deal; banks aren't built for residential investors, hard money lenders are.

s06_threereasons.title: 3 reasons pros use hard money
s06_threereasons.hook: 3 reasons experienced investors use hard money.
s06_threereasons.why_viral: Clean numbered listicle ending on the unexpected third reason (experience, not money).
s06_threereasons.spoken_gist: Speed, leverage, and the one people skip: experience. A good lender has seen thousands of deals and helps you think a project through.

s07_titlewhy.title: Why your lender demands title insurance
s07_titlewhy.hook: Why your lender insists on title insurance.
s07_titlewhy.why_viral: Turns a boring closing fee into an aha moment every buyer has wondered about.
s07_titlewhy.spoken_gist: Title insurance is a key layer of protection, guarding against unpaid liens, recording errors, and undisclosed problems.

s08_fund100pct.title: We funded 100% of purchase and rehab
s08_fund100pct.hook: We funded 100% of the purchase AND the rehab.
s08_fund100pct.why_viral: Specific real-deal numbers make it credible and screenshot-worthy; 100% financing stops flippers.
s08_fund100pct.spoken_gist: Funded at $227,500 ($167.5K purchase + $60K rehab), 100% of both, underwritten to a $350K ARV at 65% LTV.

s09_norehabcash.title: You don't need all the rehab cash
s09_norehabcash.hook: You don't need all the rehab cash up front.
s09_norehabcash.why_viral: Removes the #1 objection new flippers have: I don't have the cash.
s09_norehabcash.spoken_gist: You need to understand construction draws; on qualifying projects they finance up to 100% of the approved reno budget, released in draws.

s10_ownvslend.title: Two ways to make money in real estate
s10_ownvslend.hook: 2 ways to make money in real estate. You know one.
s10_ownvslend.why_viral: Curiosity-gap hook plus reveals the lesser-known passive-lending path.
s10_ownvslend.spoken_gist: Own the property and take the upside, or passively invest through a fund that lends against real estate in a first-lien position.
